description: 沖縄県砂防三法指定区域 [sediment-control and coastal defences and landslides and debris flows] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 沖縄県. 沖縄県内の砂防三法指定区域（砂防指定地・地すべり防止区域・急傾斜地崩壊危険区域）の位置や範囲を示したGISデータ. Coverage: 沖縄県. The portal files it under the publisher 沖縄県. Its tags are GIS, 土砂災害, 沖縄県, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-11-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
